purpose: Permit a single, receipted development-chain experiment using existing runtime-configured authority while custody rotation is pending.
authoritySource: Existing untracked runtime configuration; no secret, seed, private key, mnemonic, token, or full environment location may be copied into this record or any other tracked artifact.

limits.replayKey: experimentId plus actionDigest must be atomically claimed before broadcast

requiredReceipt.effect: A receipt records one bounded alpha action only; it is not payment, revenue, entitlement, governance, token issuance, DAO formation, or production activation.

refusals: Refuse every chain or contract outside the allowlist.
Refuse a second action with the same experimentId or actionDigest.
Refuse native spend above the cap, every token transfer, and every contract deployment.
Refuse secret disclosure or copying secret material into tracked files.
doesNotSupersede: payment, payout, token, DAO, or treasury admissions
the requirement for independent custody hardening before production or real-value operation
